name: Learned Intuition
description: AMYGDALA v3.1 — safety gate: deterministic AEGIS rules enforced pre-execution (cc-bridge PreToolUse hook + native), a validated k-NN novelty 'ask' channel that habituates with experience, and a clause-cosine incongruity check. The legacy 5-net ONNX ensemble is retired from the decision path (re-enable with legacyEnsemble).

phase.description: Deployment phase (1=observe-only soft-blocks, 2+=active neural blocking). AEGIS hard-blocks enforce regardless.

aegisEnabled.description: v3.1: AEGIS deterministic veto on by default (resolves the old manifest-off vs code-on contradiction). Set false to fully disable the rule floor.

modelsDir.description: Path to ONNX models directory (defaults to ~/src/tinkerclaw/models/amygdala)

legacyEnsemble.description: Run the retired 5-net ONNX prudence/personality ensemble in the decision path. Off by default (trained on mislabelled data; frozen-MiniLM danger classification measured below chance). The embedding pipeline is retained for novelty regardless.

hookEnforcement.description: Write the claude-cli PreToolUse hook settings so destructive-execution AEGIS rules deny synchronously on the cc-bridge runner (works under bypassPermissions). False removes the settings file (observe-only spool).
